$comment: Native runtime packs loaded by native_runtime: the ONNX Runtime CUDA provider and Sigil-built sigil_engine DLL packs. Owned by P1-D1; decision record docs/adr/0007-native-runtime-packs.md. The NVIDIA CUDA 13 runtime is in runtime-nvidia.json.

Sigil-built packs stay status 'unpublished' until the maintainer publishes them (asset hosting is local-only for now): they are installed by local import or SIGIL_LOCAL_ASSETS, staged by scripts/native/build-runtime-packs.ps1 (see scripts/native/README.md).

Engine packs follow the id convention runtime/sigil-<engine>-<variant> with a matching 'variant'; each zip holds sigil_<engine>.dll and sigil-pack.json (sizes and sha256 of its files, checked before every load). They are unpinned while unpublished because local MSVC builds are not byte-reproducible; pin them when publishing.

runtime/ort-cuda13-provider: onnxruntime_providers_cuda.dll of ONNX Runtime 1.28.0 exactly as ort-sys 2.0.0-rc.13 ships it (pyke dist efb686cb...78293), pinned. Used through register_ep_library only when the provider is not installed next to Sigil.exe. Bump with the ORT build (ADR 0001).

entries.title: ONNX Runtime CUDA provider (CUDA 13)
entries.description: The part of ONNX Runtime that talks to CUDA. Needed for CUDA acceleration when this Sigil install does not include it; works together with the NVIDIA GPU runtime.

entries.title: Native engine self-test (echo, CPU)
entries.description: A tiny test engine that plays its input back. It checks that Sigil can load its native runtime packs on this PC.

entries.title: Native engine self-test (echo, AVX2)
entries.description: The echo test engine built for processors with AVX2. It checks that Sigil picks the fastest build this PC supports.
